design_intent: Produce low-risk fixtures, jigs, packaging spacers, prototypes and approved accessories in a locally serviceable, offline-capable machine; optimise accepted useful output, not catalogue speed or nominal volume.

sources.notes: H2D technical specification; use single-nozzle volume for single-tool comparisons; max flow/speed values are manufacturer test-condition claims.

luminous_concept.not_comparable_note: The Luminous frame envelope is not a finished machine exterior and excludes panels, protrusions, cable/ventilation connections and service clearances. Derived footprint ratios are screening arithmetic only.

derived_screening.note: The first two compare nominal build volumes. The latter two are not like-for-like because the Luminous dimension is a concept frame envelope while vendor figures are finished external dimensions.

requirements.requirement: Build envelope covers the frozen actual part/job corpus.
requirements.verification: CAD bounds plus repeated real jobs; report whole-part fit and annual demand coverage.

requirements.requirement: External footprint and service clearance are measured separately.
requirements.verification: Dimensioned assembly drawing and access/service trial.

requirements.requirement: Feature-specific geometric capability is demonstrated with measurement uncertainty.
requirements.verification: ISO/ASTM 52902-inspired geometric artefact and calibrated metrology.

requirements.requirement: Accepted useful output competes with the matched route.
requirements.verification: Matched functional part and full cost/quality denominator.
Three independent machine/operator nodes, raw feature distributions.

requirements.requirement: Repair is feasible with documented tools and replacement modules.
requirements.verification: Timed module replacement, maintenance and recommissioning tests.

requirements.requirement: Machine operates offline without mandatory cloud/account dependency.
requirements.verification: External network disconnected; local control, queue and safe stop verified.

requirements.requirement: Power interruption produces a safe state and no uncontrolled restart.
requirements.verification: Controlled interruption/fault tests and protective-function verification.

requirements.requirement: Print recovery after interruption is separately qualified.
requirements.verification: Material- and state-specific recovery tests; otherwise discard/restart.

requirements.requirement: Emission controls are specific to printer/material/site.
requirements.verification: Source-control design and appropriate exposure/emission assessment.

requirements.requirement: Thermal, electrical and motion hazards are addressed independent of network/AI.
requirements.verification: Machine risk assessment, electrical review, fault tests and safety function proof.

requirements.requirement: Firmware/configuration changes are versioned, verified and recoverable.
requirements.verification: Update/rollback tests, configuration digest and local recovery.

requirements.requirement: Critical BOM dependencies have source status and alternate-source evidence or explicit risk.
requirements.verification: Machine dependency/BOM audit with dated supplier evidence.

requirements.requirement: Hardware design files have explicit licence and provenance.
requirements.verification: Exact-file licence audit, upstream attribution, legal review.

requirements.requirement: Cost, energy, materials and waste are measured per accepted output.
requirements.verification: Full cost accounting and kWh/material/scrap/rework measurement.

claim_ceiling: Vendor specifications are vendor-declared. Luminous figures are concept arithmetic. No architecture selected, machine fabricated, process qualified, safety case completed, cost advantage or SOTA superiority established.
